# ADR-012: Route aligning warp through source goto thrust

Status: chosen_for_alignment_dispatch

Concerns: Q-behavior, Q-order, Q-reproduce

## Decision

Extract the existing reviewed OriginalMode::Warp negative effect-stamp guard and combine it with the actual Goto dispatch condition. Reuse the current original_goto_thrust, source collision and integration paths.

## Rationale

Original EvolveWarp delegates to EvolveGoto before proper warp. The original and direct Rust ten-step traces exposed missing alignment acceleration at the first step.

## Alternatives

Keep zero acceleration while aligning; handwrite a separate warp steering implementation; treat a passing alignment fixture as all warp behavior.

## Consequences

All ten original positions and per-step Warp mode assertions pass in the direct Rust scenario. Proper-warp/activation event semantics, transition domains, source field side effects and required proofs remain open.
